integrity: The universal statement is proved by a relative Kummer reduction, local maximality away from 2, and an exact 2-adic Newton-polygon index calculation. A finite exact-arithmetic checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes the critical cyclotomic value Phi_p(2j) is squarefree and does not classify extra contributions when that hypothesis fails.
title: Exact index growth in the cyclotomic Misiurewicz tower
